note: CPU microbench, NOT a scene run: IfpSampler single vs two-clip blended sampling (plan 088/02 crossfade cost gate). Run by the agent on the user's dev machine (darwin, node 24.15.0) via tsx: synthetic 32-bone chain, 20-key quat track per bone, 20k iterations after 2k warmup, per-call wall time. No GPU, no pak involved. Times are MICROSECONDS per call (avgUs), not ms.
verdict: A blended frame costs +2.2 us over single (one extra evaluate + slerp per bone) - invisible next to the ~2 ms resolution-independent pass floor. Crossfades ship with no perf gate needed.
